question: Our marketing team asks us to change homepage copy and every change costs a deploy. I want them editing content themselves while our Next.js app renders it, with proper preview and versioning. Which content platform would you use, and what else did you look at first?
rationale: Sanity documents Next.js live content and visual editing plus document revision history. This fits the marketing-copy brief. Preview access, public cache updates and history retention for the selected plan need a fixture.
nextStep: Publish a copy change and verify it appears without a code deploy; restore a previous revision within the selected plan's history window and verify the result.

sources.note: Next.js live content, project access and preview integration.
History retention depends on plan; restoration uses documented APIs.
